sdedit-raw-d0.4.note: Taxis still yellow. And yet the jacket went brown to maroon, the cart changed, the skyline changed.

sdedit-raw-d0.6.note: The shipped default. Taxis went red, not pink, and this is now a different city: new people, new signage, no cart.

sdedit-raw-d0.8.note: Pink at last. The camera has moved into the road and the crowd is gone.

klein-pilot.note: Klein base, 654s. Still the same photograph; the sky drifts a shade lavender.

klein-refined.note: Klein base given a scene description instead. Pink taxis on a garish illustration.

kd-raw.note: Distilled Klein, 110s. Lamp glow, leather jacket, pretzel cart and manhole covers all survive.

kd-refined.note: Same model, given the description. My words said 'striped awning'; the real one is plain. It obeyed the words over the picture.

sdedit-refined.note: The shipped default, given the best description I could write -- it says 'painted HOT PINK' in as many words. Taxis still yellow, and the crowd, cart and buildings changed anyway.

kd-suite.note: The cart is gone and the storefront behind it is plausible. The taxis stayed yellow, because this request never mentioned them.
Same pose, tongue out, same green bowl and kibble, same window light and blurred kitchen. Only the animal changed.
The bowl is blue and it is the same dog -- same pose, ears, fur, eyes, white paws, same kibble, same window light.

sdedit-refined.note: img2img at the shipped default, told in as many words that the bowl is BLUE. Still green -- on a simple photo with one obvious object. The dog's face and the kitchen behind it shifted anyway.

kd-suite.note: Stars and Milky Way, all three penguins in the same poses on the same snow, correctly re-lit. One defect: the adult's eye patch has become a glowing orange dot.

The scarf went on the ADULT, not the chick I asked for. Everything else is untouched -- so this is a grounding failure, not a preservation one. 'The baby penguin' did not resolve; the model dressed the most salient bird.
